stats.notes: Fall 2023 entering class from the 2023-24 Common Data Set, the newest one Olin posts (the page lists 2023-24 back to 2019-20; no 2024-25 or 2025-26 edition was found). 928 applied, 201 admitted (21.7%), 98 enrolled; the in-state (Massachusetts), out-of-state and international rows add up to the totals (161+599+168, 23+157+21, 15+72+11). International first-years: 168 applied, 21 admitted, 11 enrolled. No early decision or early action: Olin has one application round and those CDS items are blank. The GPA breakdown is the only column Olin filled in ('students who submitted scores'; the other two columns are 0%), and its average GPA of 3.9 covers 100% of enrolled students. Newer IPEDS counts for fall 2024 are in the extra-year row: 1,000 applied, 252 admitted, 110 enrolled, with 25% of enrolled first-years submitting SAT scores. Olin's Class of 2030 profile (enrolled fall 2026) lists SAT middle 50% 1510-1540 and ACT 34-35 among those submitting, with 67% of applicants submitting scores. Undergraduate enrollment (405) and the nonresident count (31) are IPEDS fall 2024 (the CDS fall 2023 shows 402 total undergraduates and 31 nonresidents).

stats_extra.notes: IPEDS ADM2024 (fall 2024 entering class) via the Urban Institute Education Data Portal: 1,000 applied, 252 admitted (25.2%), 110 enrolled; College Navigator shows 25% admitted and 25% of enrolled first-years (27 students) submitting SAT scores. No ACT percentage is listed and IPEDS has no international applicant counts.

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.
